title: On well-posed energy/entropy stable boundary conditions for the rotating shallow water equations
summary: We derive and analyze well-posed, energy- and entropy-stable boundary conditions (BCs) for the two-dimensional linear and nonlinear rotating shallow water equations (RSWE) in vector invariant form. The focus of the study is on subcritical flows, which are commonly observed in atmospheric, oceanic, and geostrophic flow applications.
